prompt:
Create one standalone photorealistic photograph for Povod, a personal gift website. Use warm family documentary photography: observe a believable spontaneous moment, unforced expressions, and gentle natural imperfections. A couple aged 29 and 35 sit close together on an ordinary home sofa, one resting a head lightly against the other shoulder as they share a quiet affectionate smile. They wear simple soft knitwear. Use an intimate candid paired portrait, gentle late-afternoon window light, and an uncluttered cream-and-warm-wood living room without heart decorations. Output a vertical 4:5 composition for a website cover. Keep the lower 20 percent visually quiet for an optional website caption; place no faces, hands, or key gestures there. Preserve generous space above and beside the subjects. All people are fictional and independently invented for this image; do not reproduce anyone from a reference. Give them ordinary everyday appearances, distinct faces, realistic skin pores, age-appropriate texture, and natural clothing folds. Use an understated contemporary Russian or European everyday context without national stereotypes. Use warm neutrals, paper cream, muted terracotta, and natural surrounding colours with believable exposure, without a heavy orange filter. References inform only photographic techniques and mood; create an original scene and composition. Keep faces, hands, and important gestures within the central 70 percent of the frame, with comfortable safe margins and anatomically correct fingers, limbs, eyes, and teeth. No readable text, letters, numbers, logos, branding, watermarks, captions, borders, collages, grids, or contact sheets. No plastic skin, exaggerated smiles, duplicated people, extra limbs, or distorted perspective.

Distinct casting: the woman has a short blonde pixie haircut, and her male partner has dark skin, very short black hair and a clean-shaven face. Two fictional clearly different faces. Native aspect ratio EXACTLY 4:5, vertical.

Continuous real photograph from top to bottom; no gradient mask, fade, crossfade, dissolve, compositing or synthetic empty caption band. Any lower caption area consists of normal clothing, furniture, floor or real foreground objects, with coherent physical boundaries. No part of a body fades away.
review: Vertical affectionate couple portrait shows a blonde pixie-haired woman leaning on her dark-skinned partner. Heads, expressions, shoulder embrace and visible resting hands are coherent. Knitwear, trousers and sofa continue naturally to the bottom; central paired faces remain safe.
